Fix nothing in the realms.
assign.now: scoping - reading briefs and framework.css spacing tokens
steps: build the measurement script (private server + headless Playwright)
run at 1280 and 3440 across 22 landing pages, write spacing-<width>.json

assign.outcome: **Measured, not opined:** 1,166 visible boxes per width, every `/imagine/` realm's landing page + the padding control, at 1280 and 3440 — [raw tables + method](/framework/ai/2026-09-05/spacing-study/), [the study](/imagine/design/spacing/) (not yet in `design`'s nav — the brief reserves that wiring for the mastermind). 504 neighbour-gap comparisons; 21 cross 2.5x, 18 with a legitimate reason (heading, card/section, `<details>`, game-board grid, or a grid row-wrap this crawl caught as a measurement trap, not a defect — /imagine/review/'s uniform 6.8px gaps first read as an 8.2x spike). **3 have no reason**, all one bug: `.page-previews`'s flat `--gap: 0.8em` vs the surrounding `.md.flow`'s `--flow: 2em` (27.1px vs 10.8px, confirmed live via getComputedStyle) on platform/blogx/stream. Cramped ranking: every realm's spacing grows only 1.0-1.71x from 1280->3440 while the viewport grows 2.69x; 13 realms cluster at exactly 1.20x, sharing that same token. Proposal: give `.page-previews` the site's `--flow`/`--gap-default` clamp instead of its own flat `--gap` — fixes 3 of 3, touches all 45 gap-comparisons beside a previews wall sitewide. Fixed nothing in the realms. One line landed in the layout skill's improvements.md.
